mainEntity.name: How long does crown molding installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of crown molding installation depends on the project's scope, including the total linear footage, the number of rooms, and the complexity of the molding profile. A typical room might take one to two days. More intricate designs, high ceilings, or historical properties in areas like Oakland Hills or Montclair may require more time due to specialized cutting and fitting. We always provide an estimated timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by linear footage, number of rooms, and molding complexity. A typical room might take 1-2 days, with more intricate projects requiring longer.
